amendment_type: CONTRACTED SITE EXCLUSION / CEILING REDUCTION ONLY
authority: 12C-1K fault_catalog_policy: DERIVE ELIGIBLE SITES DETERMINISTICALLY; ACTUAL COUNT MAY NOT EXCEED FROZEN MAXIMUM
completed_batch_policy: PRESERVE; IDENTICAL GLOBAL IDS AND SITE RANGES; NEVER RESIMULATE
discovery: secworks_aes exposes 26560 eligible driven cell-output bits; the frozen 12C-1K ceiling of 26565 was derived from the Yosys generic cell count
eligibility_rule: A fault site is a distinct driven cell-output net bit: for every cell in the frozen 12C-1E generic netlist top module, in deterministic sorted order, for every port whose port_direction is 'output', every integer net bit with id >= 2 that has not already been claimed by an earlier cell/port. Constant bits 0/1 and already-claimed net bits are not sites.
root_cause: Yosys $scopeinfo hierarchy-annotation pseudo-cells are counted as cells but expose no ports, so they cannot carry a cell-output SA0/SA1 fault
